_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Live score sits inside Panic band with only 3% 12h break rate; downside cluster (dead ETF/Fed liquidity, DVOL 99) has not yet forced the next leg, so the rung holds.
next_move.brains_agree: yes on phase Panic; analyst explicit forward HOLD, narrative silent on forward so no split
next_move.confirmed_if: Fear & Greed stays 24-31 and 30d momentum near 50 with no second liquidation leg and no full dump retrace
next_move.invalidated_if: Second forced-selling leg pushes Fear & Greed into mid-teens with funding negative (Capitulation), or full retrace reclaiming Fear & Greed >32 (Denial)
